officialSources.title: STF Padjelantaleden
officialSources.type: official trail overview and stage inventory
findings: Official Swedish stage is Etapp 3: BLT Låddejåhkåstugan - BLT Árasluoktastugorna.
Distance/time is 13 km and 3-4 hours.
Description mentions easy terrain with some climbs, views over Vásstenjávrre and Allak, descent across open mountain heath, and boardwalks toward Árasluokta and the Sámi settlement.

officialSources.title: STF Padjelanta Trail
findings: English page confirms section 3 as BLT Låddejåkk cabin - BLT Árasluokta cabins, 13 km and 3-4 hours.

officialSources.title: Naturkartan BD59 Låddejåhkå-Árasluokta
findings: Distance is 13.0 km and time is 4-6 hours.
Describes a short/easy stage with the largest elevation difference on Padjelantaleden.
Route crosses Låddejåhkå by suspension bridge near a deep canyon and giant's kettles, climbs 4 km to Boarkka/Pårka, descends to Miellädno, crosses another suspension bridge, and reaches Árasluokta.
Notes many good tent pitches along the stage, including near the Miellädno suspension bridge.
GPX is stored Árasluokta-to-Låddejåhkå and must be reversed for official STF section order.

officialSources.title: BLT Låddejåhkå
findings: Låddejåhkå has 34 beds, one year-round open cabin, self-catering day room, and basic provisions subject to availability.
BLT gives distance to Árasluokta as 12 km and a grid coordinate X7485884 Y1546908 without explicit CRS.
officialSources.confidence: high for services; medium for grid coordinate reuse

officialSources.title: Padjelanta.se Låddejåkkå
findings: Gives Låddejåkkå lat/lon as 67.463684, 16.902009.
Lists distance to Arasluokta as 12 km.
Shows summer 2025 dates on the page; do not treat the season text as current for publication without recheck.
officialSources.confidence: high for coordinate; medium for currentness

officialSources.title: BLT Árasluokta
findings: Árasluokta is at the northeastern bay of Virihávrre on the route between Akka/Vájsáluokta and Stáloluokta.
BLT says there are 32 beds, one year-round open cabin, a church hut in the centre, possible boat transport across Virihaure, and basic provisions subject to availability.
BLT lists distance to Låddejåhkå as 12 km and Stáloluokta as 12 km; Padjelanta.se lists Staloluokta as 10 km.

officialSources.title: Padjelanta.se Arasluokta / Árasluokta
findings: Gives Árasluokta lat/lon as 67.373948, 16.799861.
Places the huts at Árasjåhkå's outlet to Virihaure's northeastern bay, near Jåhkågaska Sámi community's summer settlement.
Shows summer 2026 dates and 2026 prices.

officialSources.title: Länsstyrelsen Norrbotten - Aktuellt i fjällen
findings: No stage-3-specific bridge closure was found on 2026-04-29.
Latest visible notices concerned spring snow/ice and rapidly changing mountain conditions; source is dynamic and must be rechecked.

camping: Naturkartan says there are many good tent pitches along the stage, for example near the Miellädno suspension bridge.
BLT/Padjelanta hut camps support tent-camper service fees, but exact tent-area coordinates were not found.
Laponia guidance says avoid camping/resting near private cabins, huts, trails, and reindeer pens; use durable, non-sensitive ground.
fire: Do not hard-code fire as allowed. Länsstyrelsen/Jokkmokk/Krisinformation fire-ban status must be checked before publication/use.
Protected-area rules prohibit damaging vegetation and taking wood/windfalls; stove-first guidance is safest.

protectedAreas: Stage 3 is inside Padjelanta/Badjelánnda National Park and Laponia World Heritage.
Árasluokta is a Sámi settlement/cabin area associated with Jåhkågaska Sámi community; nearby private/Sámi cabins and work areas require extra respect.

dogs.rule: Dogs are prohibited in Padjelanta/Badjelánnda except leashed dogs from 1 January to 30 April; summer hiking with dogs is not allowed.

dronesAircraft.rule: Drone/aircraft use requires permission; recreational drone use should be treated as prohibited unless a permit exists.

reindeerHerding.rule: Do not disturb reindeer, herding, fences, or enclosures; Árasluokta/Miellädno is summer grazing/work land for Jåhkågaska tjiellde.

fishing.rule: Fishing is generally restricted in the national park; a limited Padjelantaleden corridor exception may apply with Jokkmokkskortet and current Länsstyrelsen rules.
fishing.importNote: Do not expose fishing as generally allowed without permit and water-specific caveats.

hunting.rule: Hunting is prohibited for ordinary visitors in the national park.

notes: Stage 3 has fixed route suspension bridges over Låddejåhkå and Miellädno according to route sources.

Laponia warns separately about a poor-condition Miellädno bridge upstream at Álggajávrre/Alkavare planned for dismantling in 2026; this appears off the Stage 3 Padjelantaleden line but is a naming-confusion risk.
Weather can damage bridges; recheck Laponia/Länsstyrelsen current-condition pages before publication.
Late June can still involve snow patches, wet ground, high meltwater, and difficult/unsafe side streams.
Assume no mobile coverage along the stage.
BLT says each cabin camp has an emergency/assistance phone in the always-open cabin.
Låddejåhkå emergency phone has a mapped coordinate; Árasluokta emergency phone does not yet have a separate coordinate.

conditionReports.title: Panipaik Kalottireitti day 26
findings: Morning light drizzle; route undulated all day and was tougher than expected because multiple hut stages were combined.
Views were excellent.
At Árasluokta, smoked fish was available, bread existed in the village, and only one hiking meal was on the shelf.
Host availability appeared informal, with signage for evening wardens or via houses in the village.
No explicit bridge or ford problem reported.
conditionReports.confidence: high for 2025 conditions; difficulty inflated by combined-day context

conditionReports.title: Far Far From Home Padjelantaleden
conditionReports.direction: reverse/combined, Stáloluokta to Árasluokta to Låddejåhkå
findings: After Árasluokta there was significant vertical, large lake/Norway views, a beautiful river crossing, then steep up and long down to Låddejåhkå.
Låddejåhkå had a river and bathing pools away from the hut.
No adverse water or bridge issue noted.
conditionReports.confidence: medium-high; river-crossing wording is ambiguous and likely bridged

conditionReports.title: AllTrails Padjelantaleden reviews
findings: July 2024 report described rain for almost six days, mosquitoes, reindeer, lakes, and great views.
August/September 2023 report described easy, beautiful trail, few hikers, helpful cabin hosts, and great conditions.
conditionReports.confidence: low-medium for this specific stage; useful whole-trail context

conditionReports.title: I-Trekkings Låddejåkka - Arasluokta - Staloluokta
findings: Reports 13 km in about 3h30.
Crossed the suspension bridge after Låddejåhkå, climbed rapidly to over 800 m, descended to Miellädno bridge, then slight climb around Áras and descent to Árasluokta.
Árasluokta had staffed hut, fish and dried reindeer meat for purchase; hikers sheltered inside from mosquitoes and paid a short day-use fee.
conditionReports.confidence: medium for terrain corroboration; operational details are old
